open_science_requirements: Foster the culture of Open Science, including knowledge valorisation and good scientific conduct such as research integrity, in all training activities (CC-11, SR-03)

Open access to publications and other research outputs including data; FAIR data management; societal engagement and citizen science to empower fellows for increased research collaboration enabled by new digital technologies (CC-12)
Career Development Plan must include planning for publications and participation in conferences and events aiming at opening science and research to citizens (CC-13, SR-04)
